about: Hand decisions about MA4 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (through scripts/msh/codegrids.py). Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
The shapes are ma1-overrides.json's and me1-overrides.json's:
match     {page, header}: the printed page and the start of the entry's header
verdict   misprint   the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
rows       a grid that prints no number for a row (N/A): its rows as the page gives them, a row it does not print as null

text       match {row}: an msh_book_text row key. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops. For a quote mark only the page image settles.
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Printed 27: no quote mark before Strength; the OCR read a speck as one.
Printed 58: one closing mark after Elements, in a face whose close looks like an open, so the OCR gave two.
Printed 58: the closing quote after elements. is printed; the OCR lost it.
Reason and Intuition print N/A: the Destroyer is an enchanted suit of armour. Health 3275 = 100 + 75 + 100 + 3000; Karma 100 is Psyche alone, so the two are played as Shift 0, as ME1's Oolafat's are.
Fighting, Agility and Strength print N/A. Health 3000 is Endurance alone and Karma 5000 = 1000 + 1000 + 3000, so the three are played as Shift 0.

The grid prints only R, I and P, and Karma 30 = 10 + 10 + 10. Its physical ranks are those of the animal each New Man was made from (a note under the grid gives a Lupine's as the example), so none is corrected: a GM builds them per character.
